decision: The competitor (Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport) is fined €1,000.
event_name: Document 33 Date 04 August 2019 Time 15:04 2019 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 1 - 4 August 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 44 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this Event by 10.1 km/h. Garry Connelly Paolo Longoni Danny Sullivan Lajos Herczeg
rules_referenced: Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Offence Car 44 Pit Lane Speeding Before The Race
